data.exact_reserve_text: The movement in the net provision for claims includes a release of GBP 52,922k (2014: GBP 34,490k) in respect of claims outstanding at the previous year end.

prior_year_events.impact_description: 3 significant airline losses affected the Syndicate in 2014, implying potential reserve redundancy in 2015.

named_events.loss_description: small net exposure to the flooding caused by the UK storms in December.

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 3210 reported a net prior year reserve release of GBP 52.922 million in 2015, representing 11.29% of its opening net claims outstanding. This favorable development was primarily driven by low catastrophe activity, intelligent risk selection, and a reserving philosophy that only takes credit for favorable experience when certainty is achieved. All business units, other than Property and Commercial, benefited from prior year reserve improvements. Marine specifically noted favorable development of prior year reserves, and Aviation's favorable claims experience in 2015, in contrast to 3 significant airline losses in 2014, contributed to this release. The Syndicate had a small net exposure to the UK storms in December 2015.
raw_causal_phrases: reserving philosophy of fully recognising any adverse experience immediately but only taking credit for favourable experience when enough time has passed to give certainty
low 2015 claims, particularly in the Cargo and Specie segments, and favourable development of prior year reserves
favourable claims experience for the year with no significant losses
